about.text: Industrial engineer by degree, core banking developer by role. I work at PT Bank Central Asia on the systems that move money between banks and the cash solution services behind them.

I did not start in IT. I graduated in industrial engineering in 2020, joined BCA as an IT Engineer, and taught myself Python and Java, then COBOL, JCL, and ISPF. The engineering degree is still the part people underestimate: it taught me to look at the process before the code, where the queue forms and which step is actually the constraint. The mainframe taught me the other half, that reliability is a discipline, not a feature.
Currently exploring where those halves point next: banking, business operations, and people development.
